about: Sector Nine coin economy: the currency, how it is earned, prices, shop rotation, missions and the item catalogue. The game server is the only thing that awards or spends it. Source of truth: sector-nine-server/economy/economy.json; sector-nine/data/economy.json is an exact copy for the client and the Unity port (economy/test.js checks they match). Plain-language rules: economy/DESIGN.md.

earn.ffaPlacement: in free-for-all with place/of given: loss + (win - loss) * (of - place) / (of - 1); 1st place = full win

softCap.about: Daily diminishing returns on match money (result + performance + lucky drop). Counted per account AND per IP (hashed); whichever has earned more today sets the rate. Resets at 00:00 UTC.

shop.resets: daily featured at 00:00 UTC, weekly set and weekly missions on Monday 00:00 UTC, same for everyone (seeded by the date)

missions.about: Server-tracked. One daily op + three weekly missions (one easy, one medium, one hard), the same for everyone, picked by the date. Only matches that pay coins count.

weekly.text: Plant or defuse the charge 4 times

catalogueSource: EXAMPLE CATALOGUE written by the economy agent before the skin files existed. Soldier items point at data/skins.json (window.S9Skins) by skinId; gun finishes point at data/gunskins.json (window.S9GunSkins) by skinId. The skins agents should keep these ids or tell the lead which ids to change here (economy/test.js reports any skinId missing from those files once they exist). preview is only the shop card fallback when S9Skins.preview / S9GunSkins.preview are missing.
